title: AtScale query lifecycle
description: Inbound Query, Planning, Outbound and Result Processing per AtScale query, from the AtScale query history. Sample code, provided as is, not supported by AtScale.

panels.title: Queries
panels.description: Queries that finished in the selected range (from the AtScale query history).

targets.expr: sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Avg duration
panels.description: End-to-end server time per query: Inbound Query + Planning + Outbound + Result Processing.

targets.expr: sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_sum{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

panels.title: p50
panels.description: Median, estimated from histogram buckets.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_bucket{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range])))

panels.title: p95
panels.description: 95th percentile, estimated from histogram buckets.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_bucket{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Aggs or cache
panels.description: Share of queries AtScale answered from an aggregate table or the query cache. Queries that never reached the warehouse are left out.

targets.expr: sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",optimization!="none"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",miss_reason!="no_warehouse"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Exporter up
panels.description: 1 = the last poll of every selected AtScale instance succeeded.

targets.expr: min(atscale_query_exporter_up{env=~"$env"})

targets.expr: sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Why queries missed aggregates and cache
Queries without aggregate or cache, by reason
panels.description: Why queries ran without an aggregate or the cache. Aggregate created by this query: the first run of a new combination of attributes and measures; AtScale created an aggregate while it ran, so the next run can use it. No aggregate created: investigate, for example an exact distinct count that no aggregate holds, or a catalog deployed while the query ran. No warehouse query: answered without a warehouse query (metadata). AtScale system query: AtScale's own queries, for example aggregate builds and statistics. Unclassified: the exporter could not read the aggregates API.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (miss_reason) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",miss_reason=~".+",miss_reason!="optimized"}[$__range])), "miss_reason", "Aggregate created by this query", "miss_reason", "aggregate_created"), "miss_reason", "No aggregate created: investigate", "miss_reason", "no_aggregate_created"), "miss_reason", "No warehouse query", "miss_reason", "no_warehouse"), "miss_reason", "AtScale system query", "miss_reason", "system"), "miss_reason", "Failed", "miss_reason", "failed"), "miss_reason", "Unclassified", "miss_reason", "unclassified")

No warehouse query: answered without a warehouse query (metadata). AtScale system query: AtScale's own queries, for example aggregate builds and statistics. panels.title: Single queries (needs the exporter's query log in Loki)
Slowest queries
panels.description: One row per query from the exporter's JSON query log, slowest first. Copy the query_id and search for it on the Queries page in AtScale Design Center. Needs Loki and the log selector at the top of the dashboard; the other panels work without it.

targets.expr: $log_selector |= "atscale_query" | json | event="atscale_query" | env=~"$env" | query_type=~"$query_type" | catalog=~"$catalog" | model=~"$model" | optimization=~"$optimization" | status=~"$status"

panels.title: Aggregate candidates and compression score (needs the AtScale engine log in Loki)
Aggregate candidates by dataset and grain
panels.description: Compression score = rows in the fact dataset / estimated rows of the proposed aggregate, as the AtScale engine logs it for each aggregate candidate (rule R050). With aggregates.create.threshold.enabled, candidates below aggregates.create.compression.threshold (default 3.0) are not created. Read from the AtScale engine log in Loki (Engine log selector at the top); the engine log has no catalog or model, so only the time range applies. Below threshold uses the Compression threshold field at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (dataset, grain) (count_over_time($engine_log_selector |= "R050 candidate" | regexp `R050 candidate (?P<candidate>\S+): score=(?P<score>[0-9.Ee+-]+) .*Dataset (?P<dataset>\S+) and (?P<grain>.*?) is ` | regexp `queryId=(?P<query_id>[0-9a-f-]+)` | label_format grain=`{{ if .grain }}{{ .grain | replace " ," ", " }}{{ else }}(no keys){{ end }}` [$__range]))

sum by (dataset, grain) (count_over_time($engine_log_selector |= "R050 candidate" | regexp `R050 candidate (?P<candidate>\S+): score=(?P<score>[0-9.Ee+-]+) .*Dataset (?P<dataset>\S+) and (?P<grain>.*?) is ` | regexp `queryId=(?P<query_id>[0-9a-f-]+)` | label_format grain=`{{ if .grain }}{{ .grain | replace " ," ", " }}{{ else }}(no keys){{ end }}` | score < $compression_threshold [$__range]))

avg by (dataset, grain) (avg_over_time($engine_log_selector |= "R050 candidate" | regexp `R050 candidate (?P<candidate>\S+): score=(?P<score>[0-9.Ee+-]+) .*Dataset (?P<dataset>\S+) and (?P<grain>.*?) is ` | regexp `queryId=(?P<query_id>[0-9a-f-]+)` | label_format grain=`{{ if .grain }}{{ .grain | replace " ," ", " }}{{ else }}(no keys){{ end }}` | unwrap score [$__range]))

panels.title: Candidates below the compression threshold
panels.description: Aggregate candidates per interval whose compression score is below the Compression threshold field, by fact dataset. Compression score = rows in the fact dataset / estimated rows of the proposed aggregate, as the AtScale engine logs it for each aggregate candidate (rule R050). With aggregates.create.threshold.enabled, candidates below aggregates.create.compression.threshold (default 3.0) are not created. Read from the AtScale engine log in Loki (Engine log selector at the top); the engine log has no catalog or model, so only the time range applies.

targets.expr: sum by (dataset) (count_over_time($engine_log_selector |= "R050 candidate" | regexp `R050 candidate (?P<candidate>\S+): score=(?P<score>[0-9.Ee+-]+) .*Dataset (?P<dataset>\S+) and (?P<grain>.*?) is ` | regexp `queryId=(?P<query_id>[0-9a-f-]+)` | label_format grain=`{{ if .grain }}{{ .grain | replace " ," ", " }}{{ else }}(no keys){{ end }}` | score < $compression_threshold [$__interval]))

panels.title: Aggregate candidates per query
panels.description: One row per aggregate candidate, lowest score first. Search the Query ID in Slowest queries or on the Queries page in AtScale Design Center. Compression score = rows in the fact dataset / estimated rows of the proposed aggregate, as the AtScale engine logs it for each aggregate candidate (rule R050). With aggregates.create.threshold.enabled, candidates below aggregates.create.compression.threshold (default 3.0) are not created. Read from the AtScale engine log in Loki (Engine log selector at the top); the engine log has no catalog or model, so only the time range applies.

targets.expr: $engine_log_selector |= "R050 candidate" | regexp `R050 candidate (?P<candidate>\S+): score=(?P<score>[0-9.Ee+-]+) .*Dataset (?P<dataset>\S+) and (?P<grain>.*?) is ` | regexp `queryId=(?P<query_id>[0-9a-f-]+)` | label_format grain=`{{ if .grain }}{{ .grain | replace " ," ", " }}{{ else }}(no keys){{ end }}`

panels.title: Average JDBC connection borrow time by pool
panels.description: From the engine's Kamon/OpenTelemetry metrics on :9095. Most JDBC traffic is the AtScale system database, so use this only to check whether a pool wait explains a high outbound wait.

targets.expr: sum by (env, jdbc_pool_name) (rate(jdbc_pool_borrow_time_seconds_sum{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (env, jdbc_pool_name) (rate(jdbc_pool_borrow_time_seconds_count{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: JDBC borrow timeouts and statements in flight
panels.description: Borrow timeouts > 0 mean queries waited for a free connection and gave up.

targets.expr: sum by (env) (increase(jdbc_pool_borrow_timeouts_total{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (env) (rate(jdbc_statements_in_flight_sum{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (env) (rate(jdbc_statements_in_flight_count{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))
